_meta.purpose: CL-PHYS-03 §4 evaluation-layer subject season windows. The evaluation layer injects a REQUIRED `season_window_policy` gate for every opportunity_id present here: an hour whose LOCAL date falls outside the subject's own MM-DD window can never become a 推薦. This table exists for subjects whose seasonal window is owned by the opportunity description/evidence but is NOT modelled as a `seasonal_state` condition in the pinned contract (editing those records is forbidden).
policy: Windows are inclusive MM-DD pairs in the subject's LOCAL calendar; start > end wraps across New Year (same rule as CL-COND-A8).
A subject absent from this table gets no gate: its contract semantics stay exactly as published (abstain, never invented).
Every entry must carry source_kind + source + asserted_at so the window can be audited against the owner data it came from.
This table never overrides a contract's own seasonal_state condition; it only covers subjects that have none.
